We are licensed and regulated by the Missouri Gaming Commission as a Sports Wagering Operator, pursuant to Missouri Revised Statutes Chapter 313, specifically under the provisions governing sports wagering enacted in 2024. We are offering online sports betting in Missouri under an agreement with Century Casino & Hotel Cape Girardeau, a licensed Missouri casino operator. Our online sports betting platform is tested by an independent test laboratory approved by the Missouri Gaming Commission to ensure fairness and proper operation.

BetMGM is committed to providing a website that is accessible, regardless of technology or ability. If you experience any difficulty in accessing any part of this website, please feel free to email us at accessibility@betmgm.com.
